teamcraft.gui.nav.all_teams.tooltip: Browse every scoreboard team currently managed by TeamCraft.
teamcraft.gui.nav.own_team.tooltip: View and edit the managed team you currently belong to.
teamcraft.gui.nav.team_config.tooltip: Configure how candidates are split, then save or create the teams.
teamcraft.gui.option.colors.example: Example: red blue for 4 teams gives red / blue / red / blue.
teamcraft.gui.option.colors.tooltip: Choose colors in team order. Leave the list empty for the default 16-color palette; a short list repeats.
teamcraft.gui.option.friendly_fire.examp: Example: when off, attacks between teammates do not deal damage.
teamcraft.gui.option.friendly_fire.toolt: Controls whether members of the same newly created team can damage each other.
teamcraft.gui.option.mode.example: Example: A, B, C, D in pairs becomes A+B / C+D in ordered mode, while random mode may differ each time.
teamcraft.gui.option.mode.tooltip: Ordered mode follows the candidate list; random mode shuffles it before assigning teams.
teamcraft.gui.option.names.example: Example: Alpha, Bravo for 3 teams gives the third team an automatic color-based name.
teamcraft.gui.option.names.tooltip: Enter display names separated by commas, semicolons, or |. Missing names are generated from team colors.
teamcraft.gui.option.players_per_team.ex: Example: 10 players and a limit of 4 produces teams of 4 / 4 / 2.
teamcraft.gui.option.players_per_team.to: The maximum number of players in each team. The required number of teams is calculated automatically.
teamcraft.gui.option.rule.example: Example: 10 players with 4 per team creates 3 teams; 10 players across 3 teams produces sizes 4 / 3 / 3.
teamcraft.gui.option.rule.tooltip: Choose whether the split is calculated from a maximum team size or a fixed number of teams.
teamcraft.gui.option.team_count.example: Example: 10 players in 3 teams produces team sizes of 4 / 3 / 3.
teamcraft.gui.option.team_count.tooltip: Creates exactly this many teams and distributes the candidate players as evenly as possible.
teamcraft.gui.own_team.color.example: Example: choosing blue makes the team name and [Team] prefix blue.
teamcraft.gui.own_team.color.tooltip: Changes this team's scoreboard color and member-name prefix color.
teamcraft.gui.own_team.friendly_fire.exa: Example: when off, attacks between your teammates do not deal damage.
teamcraft.gui.own_team.friendly_fire.too: Controls whether members of your existing team can damage each other.
teamcraft.gui.own_team.name: Display name
teamcraft.gui.own_team.name.example: Example: changing the name to Builders displays [Builders] before member names.
teamcraft.gui.own_team.name.tooltip: Changes the display name and the prefix shown before every member's name.
teamcraft.gui.own_team.none: You are not in a TeamCraft-managed team
teamcraft.gui.own_team.none.tooltip: Create the teams first, or join a team whose internal ID starts with teamcraft_.
teamcraft.gui.session_note: Applies to the next split in this server session; existing teams are unchanged
